sentiment: Even the open rooms get folded into larger houses — yet someone keeps the door lit, and the quiet work goes on.

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
stories.summary: The house where open models lived is folded into the valley's biggest wallet — the door stays, but the welcome mat changes hands.

stories.title: Mechanical Turk shutting down September 30
stories.summary: The room where invisible work was paid in pennies finally closes — its last monitors dim, and the quiet economy of small tasks goes dark.

stories.title: Asahi Linux Progress Report: Linux 7.2
stories.summary: A handful of stubborn builders keep a door open on hardware the giants ignored — proof that the quiet work, somehow, goes on.
